name: apex-character-reference-spec
rule: Use a labeled multi-angle set for identity consistency. A single-photo source is not enough for a reliable multi-angle 3D likeness.

coordinate_convention.yaw_deg: 0=front; negative=subject turns left; positive=subject turns right; +/-90=profile; 180=back
coordinate_convention.note: Confirm the coordinate convention of the target tool.

landmarks.nose: near center vertical line in front view
landmarks.coordinate_status: visual guides only; measure or annotate actual image coordinates

routing.image_video_generators: Use multi-view sheet plus genuine photos only when the tool supports them.
routing.talking_avatar_lipsync: Use slot A alone or the vendor-required source video; do not send the grid to a tool that does not support collages.
routing.three_d_photogrammetry: Use individual labeled images tagged with yaw_deg and pitch_deg; confirm tool coordinate convention.
routing.digital_twin: Follow the vendor's recording and consent process; a sheet alone does not replace required source video.

mac.status_note: The expected path returned NOT_FOUND during verification. Do not claim the image is committed until GitHub confirms it exists.
